title: Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel) - Order on Provisional Measures
publisher_or_archive: International Court of Justice, The Hague
summary: Legally binding order by the International Court of Justice finding that Palestinians in Gaza face a plausible risk of genocide under Article II of the Genocide Convention, ordering Israel to prevent genocidal acts, halt incitement, and ensure immediate unimpeded entry of basic humanitarian aid.
